findings.title: Readiness does not define required versus optional capabilities
findings.location: PRODUCT_SPEC.md FR-2 and Start a real run; ARCHITECTURE.md readiness criteria; SENSOR_ENGINE.md permission flow
findings.problem: The product promises runs can continue without GPS or audio, but prepare() requires selected sources and permissions without defining which denied or failed capabilities still permit ready or require an error.
findings.fix: Publish a capability matrix and per-capability prepare result. Make Simulation and Manual permission-free, DeviceMotion required for real cadence unless Manual is selected, GPS optional with denial disabling pace/distance, and selected-audio failures enter error with saveWithoutAudio.

findings.title: Local persistence failure has contradictory start behavior
findings.location: PRODUCT_SPEC.md FR-2 and reliability; ARCHITECTURE.md readiness; SENSOR_ENGINE.md storage failure policy
findings.problem: Readiness requires local persistence, while the sensor policy permits the live display to continue after storage failure even though local completion and interruption durability can no longer be guaranteed.
findings.fix: Either block ready/start on STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE with a retryable error, or define an explicit UNSAVED_LOCAL mode with warning, completion, history, and privacy semantics.

findings.title: Server cannot verify best pace from the permitted completion payload
findings.location: PRODUCT_SPEC.md FR-11; API_AND_DATA_MODEL.md completion contract and privacy split
findings.problem: The server is told to validate the fastest qualifying 30-second pace, but the request contains only the client result and raw GPS is never uploaded; retained aggregates may be absent or insufficient to prove it.
findings.fix: Make the client authoritative and have the server validate only bounded/null values, or send a documented privacy-preserving rolling-window proof. Do not claim server verification without evidence in the request.

findings.title: Session settings snapshots omit settings that affect session behavior
findings.location: PRODUCT_SPEC.md FR-9; API_AND_DATA_MODEL.md UserPreferences, settingsSnapshot, and preferences API
findings.problem: uploadAggregates, retainHistory, and batterySaver exist in preferences/defaults but not in the shared settingsSnapshot schema, despite settings applying to new sessions and snapshots controlling active behavior.
findings.fix: Add these fields with defaults and cross-field rules to the session snapshot and session-create contract, or explicitly classify them as global settings and define active-session reads. Reuse one schema for preferences and snapshots.

findings.title: Prisma numeric types have no JSON wire representation
findings.location: API_AND_DATA_MODEL.md Prisma schema and session/history API examples
findings.problem: activeDurationMs is BigInt and metrics are Decimal in Prisma, while examples show JSON numbers. Direct BigInt serialization fails and Decimal conversion is unspecified.
findings.fix: Define response DTO mappers and shared schemas. Convert bounded durations to JSON numbers or consistently use strings, and choose one explicit number/string policy for every Decimal field across all responses.

findings.title: The file-size limit does not bound decoded audio memory
findings.location: PRODUCT_SPEC.md FR-6; FEASIBILITY_REPORT.md audio processing; AUDIO_ENGINE.md pipeline
findings.problem: A compressed 200 MiB file can decode to a much larger PCM AudioBuffer, but no decoded-byte, duration, frame, or mobile-memory cap is defined.
findings.fix: Define and enforce a decoded-audio budget, including pre-decode duration/container checks where possible, conservative fallback limits, post-decode channels-times-frames-times-4 checks, and a user-facing rejection. Use bounded streaming/segment decoding if longer files are required.

findings.title: The playlist score contradicts its nonnegative requirement
findings.problem: An exact current-track match with confidence 1, no recency penalty, and keepBiasBpm 4 produces -4 even though scoreBpm is declared nonnegative; the relative threshold behavior is therefore ambiguous.
findings.fix: Either define scoreBpm=max(0, rawScoreBpm) and test it, or remove the nonnegative claim and define the signed-score threshold. Also specify the exact recency-penalty function rather than only its range.

findings.title: Playlist candidate eligibility is undefined for missing or low-confidence BPM
findings.location: PRODUCT_SPEC.md FR-4/FR-7; AUDIO_ENGINE.md candidate selection; API_AND_DATA_MODEL.md nullable Track.sourceBpm
findings.problem: Tracks can have null BPM, failed analysis, or low confidence, but the matcher selects among playable tracks and the score cannot evaluate a null BPM; playable is not defined as matcher-eligible.
findings.fix: Define matcher eligibility as decoded/playable audio plus finite BPM in 40..240, allow low-confidence valid BPM with the documented penalty, exclude missing BPM until correction, and specify the no-eligible-track status.

findings.title: The metrics API lacks a complete shared sample schema
findings.location: API_AND_DATA_MODEL.md RunningMetricsSample and metrics endpoint; ARCHITECTURE.md route handlers
findings.problem: The endpoint mentions a status without defining its enum or fields, persistence leaves syncStatus as an unconstrained String, and source/isSimulation combinations are only said to be validated.
findings.fix: Publish a shared Zod sample schema and status enum, define the exact session-source matrix, allowed null/value/status combinations, and persist status with a bounded enum or validated field.

findings.title: The API surface is not represented in the architecture repository shape
findings.location: ARCHITECTURE.md repository shape; API_AND_DATA_MODEL.md history, playlist, track, and playback-event APIs
findings.problem: The architecture omits dynamic history and playlist routes, all track routes, and the optional playback-event route even though the API and roadmap require them.
findings.fix: List every dynamic route and method in the repository shape with its validation and ownership module, or explicitly document a consolidated handler. Make the roadmap and API contract use the same paths.

findings.title: Retention deletion can remove an active session before completion
findings.location: PRODUCT_SPEC.md FR-9/FR-10; API_AND_DATA_MODEL.md retention update; ARCHITECTURE.md completion flow
findings.problem: retainHistory=false immediately deletes all server sessions while settings otherwise affect new sessions, so changing it during a run can make later completion or interruption return 404.
findings.fix: Disable the setting during active sessions or mark the session for deletion and let local completion finish without server history before deleting it. Define UI and retry behavior.

findings.title: Anonymous local audio persistence is underspecified
findings.location: PRODUCT_SPEC.md anonymous library and FR-6; AUDIO_ENGINE.md AudioSource.objectUrl; tasks.md M5.1
findings.problem: Object URLs are transient, but anonymous local library behavior is promised while the server stores no audio bytes. No durable Blob record, rehydration, quota, eviction, or cleanup contract exists.
findings.fix: Define an IndexedDB/local record with Blob, clientAssetId, metadata, schema version, and byte count; specify quota errors, reload URL recreation, URL revocation, and deletion order. Keep object URLs out of persisted state.

findings.title: A cited lifecycle source is dead
findings.problem: https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Page_Lifecycle_API returned 404 on 2026-10-24, although the linked Chrome lifecycle page is reachable.
findings.fix: Replace or remove the dead MDN URL, record the checked date, and recheck all browser sources during implementation and release.

findings.title: The dependency audit omits Auth.js and weakly evidences maintenance
findings.location: PRODUCT_SPEC.md authentication; ARCHITECTURE.md Auth.js boundary; FEASIBILITY_REPORT.md dependency table
findings.problem: The required Auth.js package has no version, license, repository, runtime role, or maintenance entry. Listed packages mostly use the unsupported conclusion 'active upstream repo', and GSAP remains legally conditional despite being in the locked stack.
findings.fix: Add exact Auth.js package/version, license, canonical source, compatibility, and dated maintenance evidence. Add dated release/activity evidence and legal decisions for every dependency/font; approve GSAP terms or remove it before locking the stack.

findings.title: The tertiary text token fails the stated contrast target
findings.problem: --pulse-dim #756E78 against --pulse-void #0A080D is approximately 4.04:1, below the stated 4.5:1 normal-text target, and the token is allowed for tertiary text.
findings.fix: Change the token to meet 4.5:1 for intended text backgrounds, or restrict it to non-text decoration under a semantic token that cannot be used for labels or instructions. Recalculate every semantic foreground/background pair.

findings.title: GPS rejection and jump-validation rules are not deterministic
findings.location: FEASIBILITY_REPORT.md GPS decision; SENSOR_ENGINE.md GPS pace and distance
findings.problem: Accuracy over 100m is rejected for pace but its effect on distance conflicts with the rule that poor accuracy cannot advance distance, and 'sustained sequence' for jumps over 8m/s has no count or duration.
findings.fix: Choose one acceptance rule for pace and distance and specify sustained-jump evidence, such as three consecutive fixes over at least five seconds within the accuracy limit. Define segment reset and boundary tests.

findings.title: History aggregate calculations are not reproducible
findings.location: PRODUCT_SPEC.md history and FR-11; API_AND_DATA_MODEL.md completion fields
findings.problem: Average pace, cadence, and target BPM do not specify sample weighting, interval weighting, or exclusions for gaps, pause, lost GPS, and missing estimates, so equivalent clients can produce different history.
findings.fix: Define interval-weighted aggregation and exclusions for each metric, including accepted distance over valid active time, and version the aggregate formula alongside sync-v1 if persisted.

findings.title: The one-decimal BPM input rule is not enforced
findings.location: PRODUCT_SPEC.md FR-7; AUDIO_ENGINE.md validation; API_AND_DATA_MODEL.md shared limits
findings.problem: Manual correction is required to have one decimal precision, but the shown validation only requires finite values in 40..240 and Decimal(7,2) permits two decimals.
findings.fix: Add a precision check such as Number.isInteger(value * 10) after finite/range validation to manual corrections and every API field promising one decimal, with a field-level error on failure.
